// This file is a raw-cause guard FIXTURE, not compiled package code (the .txt
// extension keeps it out of the build). Each function is one claimed raw-cause
// SYNTAX at a 5xx writeError call site, so the guard's matcher can be asserted
// to detect every form. See raw_cause_guard_test.go.
package rawcausefixture

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// msgDotError: a bare .Error() call in the message argument.
func msgDotError(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", err.Error(), nil)
}

// msgSprintf: an fmt.Sprintf whose args embed the error.
func msgSprintf(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadGateway, "x", fmt.Sprintf("failed: %v", err), nil)
}

// msgConcat: a + concatenation with a .Error() operand.
func msgConcat(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, "x", "failed: "+err.Error(), nil)
}

// msgAlias: a single-hop identifier assigned from a cause expression.
func msgAlias(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	m := err.Error()
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, "x", m, nil)
}

// detailsSmuggle: a cause assigned to an ALLOW-LISTED details key (reason),
// which the default-deny allow-list would otherwise admit to the client.
func detailsSmuggle(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadGateway, "x", "a static literal message",
		map[string]any{"reason": err.Error()})
}
